notes: Genitive absolute correctly split at its subject: ἐκείνων takes 'they' and ὁδοιπορούντων keeps the supplied 'as … were on their journey', headed on the meaning-bearing 'journey'.

ἐγγιζόντων headed on 'nigh' under rule 91 rather than on the finite 'drew', which rule 17 forbids choosing merely for being finite; the alternative is named in the unit note. Both dative phrases (τῇ ἐπαύριον, τῇ πόλει) are analysed alike under rule 21.
